description_en: Cancels real-name verification for a domain name
description_zh: 调用CancelDomainVerification取消域名实名认证审核
kebab_example: aliyun domain cancel-domain-verification --user-client-ip 127.0.0.1 --lang en --instance-id S2019270W570xxxx --action-type AUDITCONTACT --api-version 2018-01-29 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CancelDomainVerification

parameters.description_en: The IP address of the client. Set the value to **127.0.0.1**.

parameters.description_en:

*   **en**: English.
